purpose: Published snapshot of the deployed Cloudflare R2 bucket's privacy-relevant settings. The 'R2 default' prose claim is retired in favor of this artifact. Updated on every release by the maintainer from the Cloudflare dashboard.

accessLogging.how: Cloudflare dashboard → R2 → <bucket> → Settings → Logging → off. Screenshot at audit/r2-config-<sha>.png.

webAnalytics.how: Cloudflare dashboard → <zone> → Analytics → Web Analytics → not enabled.

requestBodyLogging.note: Cloudflare R2 does not log request bodies when access logging is off (the underlying S3-compatible API supports it but the bucket-level toggle controls it). No request body data leaves the origin.

atEdge: Request metadata (path, status code, response size, timing)
whatCloudflareStillSees.policy: Cloudflare's privacy policy governs this metadata. WebUtilityLab does not retain any of it. See README § 'Privacy Baseline' for the user-facing statement.

expectedBehavior: No request body in any subsequent Cloudflare access log entry
No Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon in the response body
verification.ciCheck: scripts/audit-r2-config.mjs reads this file and asserts every verifiedAt timestamp is within 30 days of the current build date. Older snapshots block the release.

schemaNote: Adding a setting requires a doc update and a reviewer-approved PR. The CI check refuses to load this file if it does not parse against audit/r2-config.schema.json.
